# Draft file fixtures

Every file under this folder is invented. None of it comes from a real person's letters,
employers or results.

- `letter.txt`, `letter-before.txt` and `letter-edited.txt` are the example in section 10 of
  `docs/specs/drafts.md`, byte for byte.

The run folder `runs/panel-01` and every other case are made at run time in a temporary folder.
